I can't access the NAS-Bench-201 tables from here, so these are priors based on the cell structure, not measured effects. Most interaction claims of this kind fail the cross-dataset consistency test, so I've kept the numbers low. Claim 15 gets the highest value because removing edge 5 leaves node 2 with no path to the output, so a direct skip edge 4 may matter more in that case.
